Mechanism: Scheduled decisions and single-writer execution
CallerOrEntry: Host AdvanceTo; calls resolve_care_wakes, resolve_wakes, resolve_nutrition_wakes, resolve_excavation_wakes, resolve_actions and resolve_autonomy_wakes
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Own world event queue and each resolver's committed state inputs
SourceRule: One transaction per call processes due keys. Perception batches care, foraging, nutrition and excavation in that order. Resolution processes batched physical actions. Reschedule batches autonomy. Environment dispatches physiology, lifecycle, reproduction, resource release and trail maintenance.
OutcomeOrTermination: Persisted watermark limits same-time insertions. The undo journal restores state and pending events on failure.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Batch snapshot timing is resolver-specific. Perception is a software phase rather than a measured sensory clock.

Mechanism: Actor ownership and same-boundary competition
CallerOrEntry: AdvanceTo Resolution; hands off to care, soil and nutrition resolvers
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Pending actions, exact stage/caste, position revision, resource and deterministic event key
SourceRule: Ordinary actions permit the earliest proposal per actor, ordered among actors by resource and seed/time/resource/actor hash. CareBegin and CareEnd use the separate pending-bout check before ordinary eligibility.
OutcomeOrTermination: Dead, duplicate, stale or non-adult-worker ordinary actions reject. An invalidated scheduled care action emits a tick without executing the bout.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Priority, exact revision and special care ownership are transaction semantics.

Mechanism: Engineering guards and published-state restoration
CallerOrEntry: restore or restore_frame; dispatches read_surface, read_physiology, read_geometry, read_social, read_long_term, read_care and read_connectors
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Checkpoint plus validated historical prefix when restoring a compact state frame
SourceRule: Distinguish spatial, motion, retrieval, care, guarded maternal, long-term and base checkpoint variants. Reconstruct events, IDs, queues, policies, ledgers and occupancy from saved state and facts.
OutcomeOrTermination: A candidate state replaces the runtime only after consistency checks succeed.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Save variants and host bounds constrain executable profiles. They supply no biological evidence.

Mechanism: Observation window and evidence typing
CallerOrEntry: Read-only query over transaction facts; care.cpp::observe and observe_legacy_action produce phase facts
RuntimeScope: Versioned care observer with journal history
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Individual-matched committed facts, phase, bout key and time bounds
SourceRule: Half-open count windows. Task residence and care residence are separate from known active/inactive bouts and time outside the union of known intervals. Count opportunities, selections, starts, completions, interruptions and actual transferred mass separately.
OutcomeOrTermination: An open timed bout is clipped at the query end. Legacy completions can retain unknown duration.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: A Completed contact, a task label and clock residence have distinct denominators. This observer does not identify sleep.

Mechanism: Inspection-only targeted queen telemetry
CallerOrEntry: Autonomy and nutrition decision hooks
RuntimeScope: Optional diagnostic Scope in apps; observation only
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Explicit target queen identity and world, computed decision and the passed sample
SourceRule: Read exact targeted queen state and record whether the queen was sampled or spatially reachable in a separate inspection output.
OutcomeOrTermination: Writes to diagnostic output only. The selected recipient/choice already belongs to the calling decision.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Global target telemetry is visible to diagnostics and is separate from ordinary donor target selection.

Mechanism: History observation across published and live facts
CallerOrEntry: WorldRuntime history reads, durable capture and continuation
RuntimeScope: Versioned checkpoint frames and live journal
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Immutable fact prefix plus sealed and active fact chunks, read by ordered EventId
SourceRule: Capture seals the current tail without changing simulation facts. Acknowledgement validates prefix identity and size before retiring only published chunks. Read resumes from the durable prefix or in-memory journal.
OutcomeOrTermination: Observation windows and event cursors see the ordered facts including archived blocks. A frame requires its matching fact prefix.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: A durable fact or replayable state provides traceability to the simulation, without establishing biological evidence.

Mechanism: Initial colony and individual identities
CallerOrEntry: Explicit application/test initialization
AvailableInputsAndLocality: World, requested caste/stage, known nest and position with bounds and clearance
SourceRule: At time zero before execution, create a LasiusNigerEngineeringFixture colony and valid living-stage ant rows. Allocate world-qualified monotonic IDs and record the starting stage, born_at and carrying capacity.
OutcomeOrTermination: Index occupancy and contact and emit ColonySeeded/AntSeeded. Seeding does not represent a natural birth.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: No founding, migration or species choice follows from a colony constructor or a seeded caste.

Mechanism: Fixture life-stage override and cleanup
CallerOrEntry: External fixture event in Environment
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Requested stage, registered individual and whether physiology owns development
SourceRule: Accept next ordinal live stage only for an unphysiologized individual, or forced death. Reject a skipped stage or repeated death. Interrupt care on a stage change.
OutcomeOrTermination: Update same AntId. Forced death removes contact and stops owned schedulers and records the fixture cause when physiology exists.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: External stage assertions and forced death are experimental controls.

Mechanism: Colony size and retained dead identities
CallerOrEntry: Host read of runtime metadata; maintained by seed, egg creation and death
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Counts of entity rows and living metadata, stable AntIds and nest stock
SourceRule: Living count changes only on seeding, funded births or death. Stage/identity history is preserved. No colony-level birth quota or death-triggered global behavior branch.
OutcomeOrTermination: A dead queen can no longer reproduce. Existing actors continue using their own schedules, reachable resources and local conditions.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Colony extinction/survival is a derived outcome, not an explicit fitness or colony migration process.

Mechanism: Food components, depot and explicit inputs
CallerOrEntry: Fixture seeding; WorldRuntime::place_food external Input command is separate
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Known physical food position and integer carbohydrate, protein, water and other mass
SourceRule: Create a nonempty source. Surface worlds require a unique walkable food cell. Collection and delivery move the same components into carried and colony stocks.
OutcomeOrTermination: Introduction, available, carried and stored ledgers change with committed transactions. Duplicate command receipt is idempotent.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: The depot is an aggregate stock at the nest position. The food representation supplies no food quality, humidity or ecological production law.

Mechanism: Walkable surface and physical observation coordinates
CallerOrEntry: configure_surface; ground_cell; navigation_cell; spatially_clear
RuntimeScope: Configured surface; legacy or opt-in continuous
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Fixed walkability grid and local position on a flat datum, plus separate geometry in mixed space
SourceRule: Legacy locate requires a cell center within numeric tolerance. Continuous motion uses a tile only as an index and checks the traversed tiles, including corner and border coverage.
OutcomeOrTermination: Invalid cells or blocked segments are rejected. Mixed space checks the segment on and above the datum in addition to actual 3D clearance.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: No antenna geometry, perceptual pixel model or curved surface heightfield.

Mechanism: Local food and step cue extraction
CallerOrEntry: resolve_wakes; can_forage; public read-only sense
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Current navigation cell, neighboring traversable segments and world-owned cell index queried only within reachable graph radius
SourceRule: Enumerate up to four legal cardinal steps. Bounded breadth-first search returns nonempty food cues with graph distance and first direction. Continuous mode checks a clear segment from each sampled point to its indexed food.
OutcomeOrTermination: An obstacle or out-of-radius cell contributes no cue. In continuous mode a selected food ID can later supply its exact position for final approach.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Uses exact food presence and geometry inside a software neighborhood. It models no odor concentration, antennal orientation or stochastic detection latency.

Mechanism: Colony-specific scalar trail cue
CallerOrEntry: resolve_wakes before choose_behavior
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Own colony, reachable next cells and their decayed scalar trail values
SourceRule: Read only the actor's colony field for each legal neighboring cell. Continuous motion provides previous-step direction from the last heading when a previous route position exists.
OutcomeOrTermination: A closed edge removes the cue. Trail values then enter the weighted step decision.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Colony identity is an exact key. No chemical identity mixture, emitted plume, polarity or antennal transduction.

Mechanism: Explicit vision, mechanosensory and environmental sensors
CallerOrEntry: Dispatches existing specialized local cues
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Geometry, scalar fields, exact identity and stock proxies in the active resolvers
SourceRule: There is no receptor, image, light, vibrational or multimodal noisy perception path. Contact, distance and clearance are direct software predicates.
OutcomeOrTermination: Behavior uses implemented neighborhood and state proxies.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Visual landmarks, odor transport, antennal contact detection, temperature and moisture sensing require separate modeling.

Mechanism: Foraging enrollment and ownership
CallerOrEntry: External activation; physiological workers use set_behavior or autonomy; prepare_forager validates home/path
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Adult worker, current body/cargo and configured surface
SourceRule: First activation requires an unloaded worker with capacity at its own exact depot. Initialize home path and heading or require prior trace continuity on reactivation.
OutcomeOrTermination: Own one perception wake or physical action at a time. Initial time-zero wake is allowed. Later starts delay.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: The system supplies the exact depot position and stored route. Starting a forager is an eligibility condition, not evidence of a natural departure rate.

Mechanism: Decision priority and bounded return
CallerOrEntry: resolve_wakes from local sense; connector paths can override the planar decision
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Own cargo/path/remembered route/decision counter and bounded LocalObservation
SourceRule: Priority is loaded home delivery, then away-from-home return when loaded, already returning or at path/move bound, then local food, then valid learned next edge, then weighted search.
OutcomeOrTermination: Follow only legal next edges. A return step missing from local choices yields default Rest with NoLegalStep. No general detour is computed.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: A finite central-place route proxy with state-priority shortcuts. Hard return limits and the meaning of Rest require separate evidence.

Mechanism: Nearest local resource and unbiased distance ties
CallerOrEntry: resolve_wakes; local food outranks memory and trail
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Current/reachable local FoodCue cell, distance, first direction and resource ID. Own RNG key
SourceRule: Minimize graph cell distance, sort equal-distance cues by physical cell and draw uniformly. When not in the source cell approach via its first edge.
OutcomeOrTermination: At the source cell select Collect. Continuous motion can first approach its exact physical position.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Nutrient quality, smell, source reliability and learned profitability do not participate in this choice.

Mechanism: Weighted exploration and direction persistence
CallerOrEntry: No higher-priority deliver/return/local-food/memory move
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Neighboring trails, route membership, predecessor and last heading, world seed, actor and individual decision ordinal
SourceRule: Exclude the predecessor when alternatives exist except a one-signal correction. Give visited cells base 1 and other cells explore_weight, add persistence for current heading, and add the optional normalized trail term before a deterministic weighted draw.
OutcomeOrTermination: Selected legal edge receives Explore or FollowTrail by signal threshold, and a later resolved move updates heading and trip.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: The model has per-individual deterministic randomness but shares configured weights. It contains no age/experience-specific search temperament beyond route state.

Mechanism: Experienced route acquisition, reversal and expiry
CallerOrEntry: Successful collection or movement; choose_behavior consumes stored route
RuntimeScope: Enabled forager with memory flag for learned food route
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Actual tile transitions, the current loop-erased path, successful resource ID and last learning time
SourceRule: Tile moves append or truncate at an already visited cell. Successful collection records the current path and timestamp as one learned route. Return traces the current path backward. Memory reuses only the next legal step at a recognized cell.
OutcomeOrTermination: Forget on strict expiry, encountered empty endpoint or blocked learned next step. A worker off the learned path can still explore and retain the memory until another invalidation.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: No route graph of several foods, landmark perception, continuous integration of home vector or adaptive travel-cost learning.

Mechanism: Food uptake and load eligibility
CallerOrEntry: CollectFood proposal after foraging decision or explicit fixture action
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Physical contact, walkable/clear access, exact food stock, requested mass, food and soil cargo capacity
SourceRule: Reject out of reach, depleted, full or loaded-clearance failure. Amount is minimum of request, source and remaining capacity. Move the source's current constituent proportions to external cargo.
OutcomeOrTermination: Commit FoodCollected with Success or Partial. Successful collection switches forager to Return and may learn its path.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Collection uses bulk mass and instant commit after a fixture action duration. No ingestion/palatability behavior at food during this action.

Mechanism: Delivery to actual depot and empty return
CallerOrEntry: DeliverFood; after_action handles home-cell/connector continuation and notify_return
RuntimeScope: Adult worker forager or external proposal
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Exact nest coordinates, carried food, contact and clearance
SourceRule: Deliver only at reachable nest contact and, for legacy surface, matching cell. Move all food cargo into colony nest stock. A remembered home tile in a mixed world may initiate traversal to the depot for an empty return.
OutcomeOrTermination: Successful delivery resets trip/mode. Return hooks can schedule a rest or post-intake opportunity under the long-term policy.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: A single exact depot and non-selective unloading replace real nest distribution.

Mechanism: Movement geometry, speed and execution failure
CallerOrEntry: Move proposal from foraging, excavation or external fixture
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Actor pose, proposed endpoint, issued and scheduled time, world bounds, body/load envelope
SourceRule: Require clear swept segment and elapsed-time speed limit. Legacy planar resolution also requires adjacent located cells. Continuous foraging move clock uses maximum of configured step/connector time and a rounded travel-time lower bound.
OutcomeOrTermination: Moved updates position/revision and indexes. Rejection leaves the position unchanged and lets owner logic decide the next wake.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Endpoint translation, fixed speed limits and cubic clearance. Distinct gait, turning mechanics and load posture are absent.

Mechanism: Discovered surface-to-depot connector
CallerOrEntry: prepare_forager and task eligibility before departure
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Exact home pose, loaded clearance, solid/edits and known surface plane. Search only up to route and node bounds
SourceRule: Search quantized passable neighbor edges toward a surface plane offset by loaded half-extent. Require an open neighboring surface tile with clear access. Cache one path per ant and walk it one waypoint at a time.
OutcomeOrTermination: Blockage stops a leg. Known connector checks every segment for future departure and can be reused when reopened.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Height-guided local search is a navigation affordance. It contains no experience-based discovery of an alternative known route after permanent blockage.

Mechanism: Foraging wake, suspension and terminal ownership
CallerOrEntry: resolve_actions or death cleanup; program changes can disable the same owned events
RuntimeScope: Enabled forager or disabled remembered forager
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Actual action result, active wake/action IDs and mode
SourceRule: Reschedule after a completed or rejected owned action. Increment failure counters for rejection. Stop removes outstanding owned events and disables the forager while preserving its record.
OutcomeOrTermination: Return into home cell resets empty trip. Cargo, travel ownership and blockages can keep an actor from changing ordinary task.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: A blocked attempt can recur. The bounded route policy has no adaptive failure-time alternative.

Mechanism: Loaded move deposition rule
CallerOrEntry: Successful owned movement across a surface cell
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Previous food cargo, actual tile arrival, own colony key, existing cell field and timestamp
SourceRule: If the actor carried food before the movement, deposit a fixed increment to the destination cell capped at trail_cap_units. Connector moves and within-tile approaches are separate branches and do not deposit through this branch.
OutcomeOrTermination: Store new field and record effective deposited units on Moved. Zero remaining capacity at the cap yields zero added units.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: No source quality, follower encounter, intent-dependent output, deposited physical mass or gland budget.

Mechanism: Decay, cutoff and sparse trail maintenance
CallerOrEntry: WorldRuntime::sense, after_action, maintain_trails and surface_snapshot
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Per-colony per-cell stored concentration scalar, elapsed time and configured half-life
SourceRule: Apply exponential decay on read/write and periodic maintenance. Clamp effective concentration to zero below cutoff. Periodic environment events erase zero entries and update the rest.
OutcomeOrTermination: Repeated local refresh and deposits. Capacity exhaustion throws instead of silently changing footprint.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Each cell decays independently. There is no diffusion, deposition footprint, fluid transport or substrate/temperature-dependent kinetics.

Mechanism: Trail influence, bounded correction and private memory precedence
CallerOrEntry: resolve_wakes after memory attempt and local-food priority
RuntimeScope: Trail sensing and weighting enabled, unless a blind control changes settings
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Decayed reachable-cell cues with previous-step and current path
SourceRule: Only one visible signal on the predecessor can permit immediate reversal. Add trail_weight times capped normalized signal to the exploration and persistence weights. A chosen edge with signal above cutoff is labeled FollowTrail.
OutcomeOrTermination: Draw once among allowed local steps. A FollowTrail label can occur even at trail_weight zero if trails remain enabled and the chosen edge carries a visible signal.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: An observed labeled step identifies signal occupancy, while causal recruitment requires independent comparisons and outcomes.

Mechanism: Colony recruitment as emergent outcome
CallerOrEntry: Independent enrolled workers read a shared field
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Each worker's local observation, private route and same-colony deposits
SourceRule: Workers can change their steps through the shared field. Departure uses the individual enrollment/autonomy policy. There is no separate recruit state, scout announcement, antennal recruitment exchange or direct food sharing of coordinates.
OutcomeOrTermination: Discovery, route following, return and delivery are measured separately. Social recruitment benefit remains a historical validation question.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: The existence of a shared scalar channel does not identify or validate colony recruitment behavior.

Mechanism: Trail, discovery and trip observables
CallerOrEntry: Read-only queries over committed moves, discovered cues and instantaneous field decay
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Whole-world aggregate histories and sparse trail map
SourceRule: Report visited tiles, undirected edge traversals, counted first discovery, active trail cells, current units and deposited-minus-current units. Discovery is a recorded cue and differs from a collection.
OutcomeOrTermination: Counts are fact/cue derived. The earliest cue time and then actor order determine the first discovery summary.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: The aggregate is not fed into the individual model. Evaporated units are bookkeeping in abstract field units.

Mechanism: Contact neighborhood and exact filtering
CallerOrEntry: Autonomy and nutrition wakes; paired exhaustive control
RuntimeScope: Opt-in social policy, bounded by default
AvailableInputsAndLocality: 27 neighboring buckets with ranked identities, then self/alive/own-colony, exact Euclidean distance and clearance checks
SourceRule: Sample without replacement using Floyd ranks up to encounter_budget before physical filtering. Excluded identities consume sampled slots. Sort accepted candidates by ID. Unbounded mode enumerates all identities before the same filter.
OutcomeOrTermination: Return accepted sample only, with separate computational work counts. Seed, movement and death maintain the derived index.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Contact rank draws are an encounter proxy. There is no persistent network, speed-dependent encounter rate or tactile detection delay.

Mechanism: Separate cargo, crop, body stores and losses
CallerOrEntry: Physiology registration, resource and nutrient transactions; read-only totals
AvailableInputsAndLocality: External cargo, nest depot, crop, body energy, tissue protein, hydration, oxidized carbohydrate and lost water
SourceRule: Source/nest/crop/body quantities and consumed sinks are distinct. Endogenous birth initial state is linked by mother and not counted again as external input. Inert other material occupies storage capacity.
OutcomeOrTermination: Accounted mass includes reserves and dead individuals' retained inventories. Energy adds initial exogenous stores and carbohydrate conversion, with dissipation as a sink.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: No lipid pool, organ compartment, digestion products or carcass turnover is modeled by these accounting quantities.

Mechanism: Recipient ingredient deficit and eligibility signal
CallerOrEntry: resolve_nutrition_wakes, resolve_nutrition_action, resolve_autonomy_wakes and care feeding
RuntimeScope: Demand-sensitive social mode; long-term metabolic larva extension
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Exact simulated recipient energy, hydration, crop composition, tissue and capacity after local candidate selection
SourceRule: Deficits subtract crop reserves from body headroom and protein targets. Signal larval protein deficit, and in long-term mode urgent larval energy/water. Adult signal uses sub-quarter body reserves or deficient adult crop protein target.
OutcomeOrTermination: The signal selects eligible local work. A successful exchange separately caps ingredient supply by actual nutrient_demand and crop room.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Local information access is stronger than a noisy contact cue. Thresholded stored quantities supply no mechanism for measured solicitation, composition sensing or stage-specific signaling.

Mechanism: Automatic donor recipient selection and action priority
CallerOrEntry: NutritionWake for Rest or Nurse; gift-first and scarcity continuation flags are explicit
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Own stores/cargo, reachable depot, and sampled contact candidates or the filtered legacy scan
SourceRule: Default action is Rest. Gift-first tries compatible Nurse transfer first unless the donor is urgent without matching crop. Recycling in Rest can precede intake. Otherwise intake uses cargo then reachable depot below half crop, followed by legacy gift attempt when enabled by that order.
OutcomeOrTermination: For Nurse draw uniformly by reservoir over eligible candidates. Proposal uses configured transfer limit. Commit rechecks physical reach and actual inventories.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: No measured donor waiting duration, solicitation signaling, observed feeding-rate law or optimal colony allocator. Legacy choice can consider a geometrically blocked donor-recipient pair until resolution.

Mechanism: Intake from cargo and accessible depot
CallerOrEntry: Owned or explicit nutrition proposal resolved as IngestCargo / WithdrawNest
RuntimeScope: Ordinary adult worker actions; long-term demand cap optional
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Reachability to nest for withdrawal, available source stock and crop room
SourceRule: Bound intake by requested mass, available supply and crop room. Long-term depot withdrawal caps each ingredient by own demand, or max of own and freshly sampled recipient demands for Nurse.
OutcomeOrTermination: Subtract real mass from cargo/depot ledger and add to crop. Emit CargoIngested or NestIngested with actual amount and partial status. No automatic conversion into body energy at this commit.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Candidate maxima are exact local proxies rather than sensed chemistry. The aggregate depot is a software food pool.

Mechanism: Validated ordinary mouth-to-mouth transfer
CallerOrEntry: Trophallaxis via ordinary action resolution; separate care FeedBrood can use this helper
RuntimeScope: Manual paused worker or Nurse; care route has separate caregiver guards
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Living same-colony Adult/Larva recipient, stage, contact, geometry clearance, actual crop stock and recipient room
SourceRule: Reject invalid/dead/unreachable recipient, disabled exchange, no room or supply. Demand-sensitive mode intersects donor crop and recipient ingredient deficit. Transfer proportional bounded integer composition between crops.
OutcomeOrTermination: Commit NutritionTransferred with target in payload. A rejection transfers no nutrition. Absorption remains scheduled separately.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: The transaction lacks contact initiation/acceptance physiology and oral exchange duration. A recipient pupa or egg is ineligible.

Mechanism: Protein surplus return and post-intake wake
CallerOrEntry: ReturnProtein proposal or Rest choice; continue_nutrition_behavior follows successful depot withdrawal
RuntimeScope: Opt-in long-term resource recycling and post-intake policy
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Own crop protein, exact reachable nest, actual previous fact and action ownership
SourceRule: Move requested bounded pure protein from crop back to depot when allowed. Auto recycling selects Rest with protein at reachable depot. A successful Nurse NestIngested may schedule the next contact wake at +1 ms.
OutcomeOrTermination: ProteinRecycled records real mass. Failed intake uses the ordinary behavior interval.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: The recycling rule does not model secretion, disposal, selective reclamation or measured queen feeding time.

Mechanism: Worker provisioning of queens versus larval nutrition
CallerOrEntry: Local Nurse encounters, recipient selection and resolve_nutrition_action
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Adult queen appears as an eligible Adult recipient if sampled, reachable and signaled need matches crop. Larvae use stage-specific deficit.
SourceRule: Queen adult_protein_target_ug can make stored crop protein eligible for provision. No separate weighted queen recipient priority. Adult received protein remains crop stock available to funded egg allocation or transfer.
OutcomeOrTermination: Same exchange transaction as ordinary feeding. Larval protein is later assimilated into tissue, whereas adult absorption only moves carbohydrate/water.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Queen access depends on contact, task and inventory. Actual maternal provisioning benefit and stage/caste-specific dose remain open.

Mechanism: Physiology registration and exact initial reserves
CallerOrEntry: Time-zero host enrollment or separate funded offspring creation
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Seeded crop, body energy, hydration, tissue and full per-individual configuration
SourceRule: Initialize all compartments, first absorption clock and owned physiology event. Long intervals, alternate water clock and queen-specific adult crop target require long-term contract.
OutcomeOrTermination: Initial introduced stores recorded separately. Physiology-owned development excludes conflicting forced non-death stages.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: No mass-derived, age-derived or species/caste-specific rate mapping. Different castes may receive different fixture inputs explicitly.

Mechanism: Piecewise basal and task-state energy cost
CallerOrEntry: Synchronize at events, program changes, transfer, digging, reproduction and detached reads
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Current stage, task state, elapsed milliseconds and fixed per-individual rates
SourceRule: Apply basal_nj_per_ms for every live stage and add active_nj_per_ms for an Adult in Nurse, Forage or Excavate. Debit min(current energy, rate * elapsed) and count dissipation.
OutcomeOrTermination: Task switch settles old interval before changing state. Rest and Paused still consume basal energy.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Program residence, including waiting in a task, is the activity proxy. Individual size, temperature, gait, load-dependent work and tissue-specific maintenance are absent.

Mechanism: Discrete assimilation and bounded energy conversion
CallerOrEntry: execute_physiology at an absorption wake after survival and stage checks
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Crop components, capacity headroom, interval-based rate allowance and fractional integer remainders
SourceRule: Convert eligible crop carbohydrate by fixed nJ per ug and store water. Only larvae move crop protein into tissue up to the larval requirement. Eggs/pupae advance the absorption clock without substrate transfer.
OutcomeOrTermination: Pulse records real consumed nutrients. Energy gain is limited by capacity, not a guarantee of survival.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Fixed coefficient models usable energy without metabolic substrate choice, temperature response, crop-to-gut delay or adult protein assimilation.

Mechanism: Water store and loss dynamics
CallerOrEntry: Physiology events and pre-action synchronization
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Hydration mass, fixed loss per configured period and elapsed time
SourceRule: Accumulate integer water loss with remainder and debit at most current hydration. Crop water can replenish hydration at Adult/Larva absorption pulses.
OutcomeOrTermination: Zero hydration is terminal at an owned physiology event. Simultaneous energy depletion is coded as energy death.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: No ambient RH, vapor pressure deficit, cuticle/wet substrate exchange, behavior-specific drinking state or caste scaling.

Mechanism: Missing environmental and allometric physiology
CallerOrEntry: Existing physiology updates consult scalar configuration, stage and program
AvailableInputsAndLocality: No temperature, body mass, age, oxygen, lipid, endocrine or hydration feedback field consumed in rate equations
SourceRule: Parameter values can differ by externally selected individual fixture. No caste or ontogenetic scaling function, dynamic temperature development response, respiration or diapause.
OutcomeOrTermination: Fixture durations and reserve depletion set the outcomes.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Thermal and humidity experiments require matching endpoints and a mechanism capable of consuming those stimuli.

Mechanism: Physiological egg, larva, pupa and adult transition
CallerOrEntry: Owned Environment event scheduled by next_physiology
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Current stage, elapsed time, tissue protein and reserve status
SourceRule: Egg and pupa progress if alive. Larval stage time accrues only after tissue requirement. At exact stage duration update to next ordinal on same ID and reset progress.
OutcomeOrTermination: When an eligible enrolled worker becomes Adult, schedule autonomy. At an individual event, depletion precedes stage change, which precedes absorption. Scheduling can allow a further due pulse at the same time.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: A single larval tissue gate stands in for continuous growth, molting and instar timing. Stage-duration values are fixtures.

Mechanism: Instars, callow maturation and reproductive caste differentiation
CallerOrEntry: seed_ant, execute_physiology and execute_reproduction
RuntimeScope: No state machine for these developmental distinctions
AvailableInputsAndLocality: One Egg/Larva/Pupa/Adult/Dead enum and a separate seeded caste enum
SourceRule: Larval instars, molts, prepupa and post-emergence maturation have no distinct executable states. Funded reproduction initializes worker eggs. Male and queen may be explicitly seeded as castes.
OutcomeOrTermination: Worker emergence activates adult eligibility, with no separate callow age threshold.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Sex allocation, sexual development, mating and colony founding are not modeled by the stage enum.

Mechanism: Physiological death and terminal scheduling
CallerOrEntry: Environment wake settles maintenance/water losses first; lifecycle fixtures can force death
RuntimeScope: Physiology-enabled live stages, plus fixture override
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Remaining body energy and hydration. Owned programs and physical care custody
SourceRule: A zero energy or water store commits Dead. Energy wins the cause label when both are zero. Clear owned physiology, nutrition, reproduction, foraging, excavation, care and autonomy work.
OutcomeOrTermination: Preserve dead identity and recorded reserves. Contact removal and state checks prevent ordinary further actions. The existing stored food/soil ledgers do not automatically recycle dead individuals' inventory.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Age, disease, injury and thermal mortality are outside this deterministic reserve model.

Mechanism: Age, hazards and sex-specific lifespan
CallerOrEntry: Existing physiology event and external death fixture
AvailableInputsAndLocality: No age-dependent hazard, survival distribution, disease, predation or thermal shock input to physiological death
SourceRule: Only measured-in-engine reserve exhaustion or external fixture death changes life state to Dead. born_at is identity history and can be used as care context metadata.
OutcomeOrTermination: Long colony trajectories reflect local fixture dynamics and deterministic thresholds.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Mortality rates and worker/queen lifespan cannot be inferred from the separate caste enum.

Mechanism: Autonomy enrollment and wake ownership
CallerOrEntry: set_autonomy / reproduction / developmental wake / death
RuntimeScope: Social configuration with living physiological worker or integrated adult queen
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Own caste, stage, care ownership and pending resolutions
SourceRule: Reject concurrent dedicated care or externally owned resolution as applicable. Mark enrollment and enqueue at the social decision interval only for adults.
OutcomeOrTermination: Disable or death removes ordinary wake. An enrolled juvenile starts regular decisions only on adulthood.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Enrollment is explicit at setup or inherited for born workers. Caste-specific adult behavior is not inferred from age.

Mechanism: Eligibility to switch daily programs
CallerOrEntry: AutonomyWake
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Own current program, time since change, body reserves, cargo and exact own depot position
SourceRule: Switch only when stationary or exactly at depot and not carrying food or soil. Ordinary workers also wait for minimum program time except paused or forced return-to-rest. Active care leases keep ordinary wake but block selection.
OutcomeOrTermination: Queen can start eligible care after previous change time when not urgent. Ongoing traveling worker remains in program until an eligible boundary.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Depot equality and cargo ownership are exact model state. No age polyethism, individual experience score for division of labor or circadian schedule.

Mechanism: Local worker program lottery and continuation
CallerOrEntry: AutonomyWake
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Bounded contact sample, compatible locally accessible depot stock, self stores, true nearby material and local care opportunity
SourceRule: Urgency plus usable stock selects Rest. Optional continuation holds Nurse if a sampled recipient can use carried nutrition. Otherwise draw weighted Rest, Forage, social Nurse, Excavate or care lease from private seed.

SourceBoundaryOrGap: Uses modeled exact nutrient deficits, exact stock when in contact and reachable-site counts as local signal proxies. No colony-wide optimizer.

Mechanism: Funded maternal egg production

CallerOrEntry: Funded maternal reproduction

SourceRule: Subtract egg protein and water, export egg energy and record separate reproductive dissipation. Copy mother's physiology coefficients to child and set adult protein target to zero.

AvailableInputsAndLocality: Explicit finite ingredient reserves, interval, per-pulse limits and global simulated time

SourceRule: Enumerate reachable neighbors using the contact index, then screen for relevant brood and adult workers. Enumerate in-range opportunities before displaced-target lock filtering.

Mechanism: Species, individual and environment care enrollment

CallerOrEntry: CareWake, following completed worker contact

SourceRule: When eligible draw contact separately before brood handling. A completed CloseWorkerContact records the only contact-memory refresh. Linear recency multiplier depresses the queen's new brood-choice probability.

Mechanism: Brood acquisition, short persistence and approach

AvailableInputsAndLocality: Eligible local brood positions, own body state, known shelter and at most one target/visited pickup site
SourceRule: Prefer displaced brood when any is visible. Screen displaced locks owned by others and clear active target on loss. Draw uniformly when starting, otherwise retain only a still-visible displaced target.

Mechanism: Stationary brood handling and real feeding

Mechanism: Timed pickup, movement with custody and placement

AvailableInputsAndLocality: Stable actor and target IDs, active bout, exclusive lock, known shelter, real position and load extent
SourceRule: Revalidate life, stage, ownership, range and path at start and finish. Successful pickup records custody and, under continuous motion, the relative grip offset. Loaded segments move both bodies atomically.
OutcomeOrTermination: Placement succeeds only when the still-held brood is within shelter contact and both positions are clear. Release target without snapping to shelter.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Rigid translated grip with no rotation, posture or load-dependent reserve beyond configured geometry, speed and common activity accounting.

Mechanism: Movement segment duration, clearance and legacy stride
CallerOrEntry: Care movement planning and execution
RuntimeScope: Dedicated, timed, integrated and optional continuous spatial contracts
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Real distance, caste and load status, grid or 3D geometry, speed cap, configured handling durations
SourceRule: Continuous movement clips straight toward target and can try local reducing axes if blocked. Legacy timed surface motion requires a step at least one cell. Timed duration rounds up distance/speed, with one-millisecond floor or arrangement minimum.
OutcomeOrTermination: Movement commits only at successful end, with both real sweeps checked. Timed pickup and place use separate handling clocks. Untimed mode uses the common bout duration.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: Piecewise endpoints, no continuous ant body orientation, trajectory inside the bout or learned navigation around arbitrary blockage. Loaded speed is independent fixture.

Mechanism: Search, one pickup-site revisit and return to shelter

RuntimeScope: Dedicated search or integrated shelter-return motor
AvailableInputsAndLocality: Current visible brood, previously visited pickup site and familiar shelter, no remote brood map
SourceRule: Choose return, revisit or local acquisition according to current state. Dedicated empty-view walk draws one of four planar directions. Search counter reloads when empty and is a cadence counter, not a lifetime search cap.
OutcomeOrTermination: Completed revisit consumes memory. Integrated care clears pickup memory and returns to shelter after final handling or failure. It does not use the dedicated random empty-view walk.
SourceBoundaryOrGap: No brood trail pheromone, visual panorama or search-path learning. Preferred revisit competes with new visible displaced targets.

Mechanism: Cancellation and reacquisition boundaries
